issues.description: Class attribute GroverTwoQubitWithoutAuxiliaryQubit.number_of_qubits_query_register is assigned a float literal (0.0) in the template, but the solution assigns an integer (2) and the problem statement describes a two-qubit exercise. The template then passes this attribute to QuantumRegister(self.number_of_qubits_query_register). QuantumRegister requires an integer number of qubits; using a float will raise a TypeError at construction and prevents students from instantiating the circuit or running the exercise.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template, change the attribute assignment to an integer consistent with the exercise and the solution. For example: self.number_of_qubits_query_register = 2. This ensures QuantumRegister is constructed with an integer and matches the two-qubit exercise described in the problem statement.
